mappings.payload:

+# Check for libsoup

+AC_ARG_ENABLE(httpd, [  --enable-httpd         build with httpd support(default=yes)])

+  enable_httpd=yes

+    have_libsoup="no (libsoup not found)")
+else
+  enable_httpd=no 
+fi
+if test "x$have_libsoup" = "xyes"; then
+  AC_DEFINE(HAVE_LIBSOUP, 1, [Define to 1 if libsoup is available])
+  AC_DEFINE(USE_HTTPD, 1, [Define to 1 if using httpd modules])
+fi
+AM_CONDITIONAL(USE_HTTPD, test "x$enable_httpd" = xyes)
+
+
